# Polars functions and selectors

This page maps 163 Polars names onto their Batcher spellings, grouped by the class or module they live on. Each row reads in both directions. {doc}`index` explains the statuses and the waves.

To rewrite Polars code onto these spellings, run the codemod:

```bash
python -m batcher.migrate --from polars --to batcher <paths>
```

Replace `<paths>` with the files or directories to rewrite. This direction is implemented. Without `--write` the command prints a diff and changes nothing, and `--write` applies it.
